newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hanwa emergency fund in works - Japan source.
newsitem.headline: Hanwa emergency fund in works - Japan source.

text.p: The Bank of Japan will establish an emergency fund for the failed Hanwa Bank so that it can cope with the rush of withdrawals on its deposits, a source close to the Japanese government told Reuters.
The source said that the fund will be used as a loan to the bank, whose operation will be suspended by the Ministry of Finance on Thursday. He did not specify an amount.

He said that the loans will be made to prevent a crisis in the Wakayama-based bank should there be a rush to withdraw deposits after news of its suspension. The MOF earlier said the suspension is due to unrecoverable bad loans at the bank.
